description: A Python script implementing a conversational AI bot using Gemini for LLM, STT, TTS, and image generation, with integration of Google services and custom pipeline setup.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context messages for the LLM conversation.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: PipelineTask

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of a pipeline.
